resources.string: Testing StartSession once; NO VALIDATEPAIR / TLS / STARTSERVICE. Wait for cleanup and save report...

STARTSESSION ONLY — NO VALIDATEPAIR / TLS / STARTSERVICE\n\nThis changes live iPhone session state. Requires exactly one readable accepted protected record and the already-transitioned iPhone with existing USB permission and active configuration 5. This test never prepares USB mode or requests permission. Opens one fresh Lockdown connection, QueryType, checks device association, then sends StartSession once using the existing record. No Pair, ValidatePair, SetValue, identity generation, record writes, retries or reconnect. If SSL is explicitly false and SessionID valid, sends StopSession once. If TLS is required, closes without TLS or plaintext StopSession; session stop is NOT confirmed. No services, authentication, NCM or CarPlay. Do not approve new Trust prompts. Save report and STOP. Proceed?
Phase 3D.2U — Controlled Lockdown TLS round trip
Test Lockdown TLS round trip (NO SERVICES)
StartSession once, TLS once on the same stream, one encrypted QueryType, encrypted StopSession. NO PAIR / VALIDATEPAIR / STARTSERVICE. Wait for cleanup and save report...

STARTSESSION + TLS + ONE ENCRYPTED QUERYTYPE + STOPSESSION ONLY — NO PAIR / VALIDATEPAIR / STARTSERVICE\n\nThis changes live iPhone session state. Requires exactly one readable accepted protected record and the already-transitioned iPhone with existing USB permission and active configuration 5. Never prepares USB mode or requests permission. Opens one fresh Lockdown connection, QueryType, checks device association, sends StartSession once, and only if SessionID is valid and EnableSessionSSL=true starts TLS on the SAME connection using the existing record. The iPhone must prove the paired device key or TLS stops. Then one encrypted QueryType and one encrypted StopSession(SessionID), then cleanup. No Pair, ValidatePair, SetValue, identity generation, record writes, retries, reconnect, StartService, CarKit, iAP2, MFi, NCM, AirPlay or CarPlay. Do not approve new Trust prompts. Save report and STOP. Proceed?

ONE ENCRYPTED STARTSERVICE + ENCRYPTED STOPSESSION — NO SERVICE CONNECTION / CARKIT TRAFFIC\n\nThis changes live iPhone session state. Requires exactly one readable accepted PAIRED record (not VALIDATED), the already-transitioned Apple USB device, existing USB permission, active configuration 5, and its scoped USBMUX interface. Never prepares USB mode or requests permission. Opens one fresh Lockdown TCP62078 stream, QueryType, verifies association, sends StartSession once, then authenticates TLS on that SAME stream against the paired device certificate. Sends exactly one encrypted StartService for com.apple.carkit.service. Safely reports only response error status, whether the service port is valid, and EnableServiceSSL; the port is NEVER contacted. Sends StopSession once over authenticated TLS and confirms its response before cleanup. No Pair, ValidatePair, SetValue, identity generation, record writes, retries, reconnect, CarKit traffic, iAP2, MFi, NCM, AirPlay or CarPlay. If TLS validation fails or TLS is unavailable, STOP; no downgrade. Do not approve Trust prompts. Hardware testing is a separate manual action. Save report and STOP. Proceed?
StartSession once, TLS on the same stream, one encrypted CarKit StartService, encrypted StopSession, cleanup. NO SERVICE CONNECTION OR CAR KIT TRAFFIC. Wait for cleanup and save report...
Phase 3D.2W — Controlled CarKit service TCP/TLS connection
Test CarKit service TLS (NO APP TRAFFIC)
Running one Lockdown session, one CarKit service TCP connection and TLS handshake, then encrypted StopSession and cleanup. NO CARKIT APPLICATION TRAFFIC. Wait and save the report...

ONE SERVICE TCP CONNECTION + AUTHENTICATED TLS HANDSHAKE ONLY — NO CARKIT APPLICATION TRAFFIC\n\nThis changes live iPhone session state. Requires one readable existing PAIRED record, the already-transitioned Apple USB device, existing permission, active configuration 5, and its scoped USBMUX interface. This one manual action performs QueryType and identity association, StartSession once, authenticated Lockdown TLS, and one encrypted StartService for com.apple.carkit.service. Only if StartService succeeds with a valid port and EnableServiceSSL=true, it opens one additional USBMUX TCP socket to that port while preserving the Lockdown TLS socket, then performs one TLS handshake using the stored paired-device credentials and peer certificate pin. It sends no application data. It closes service TLS/TCP before encrypted StopSession on Lockdown TLS, then closes Lockdown and USB resources. No Pair, ValidatePair, SetValue, identity regeneration, record writes, retries, reconnect, CarKit commands, iAP2, MFi, NCM, AirPlay, or CarPlay. Do not approve Trust prompts. If TLS behavior is unsupported or peer validation fails, save the report and STOP; never weaken certificate checks or retry. Proceed?
Reading provider configuration and passive access metadata only; no provider initialization, I2C transactions, USB permission/open, network, or iPhone access...
Validating existing DiPlay pair; NO PAIR. Wait for cleanup and save report...

Validate existing DiPlay pair only\n\nRequires a verified persisted PAIRED or VALIDATED record before USB open. Missing, PREPARED, corrupt or mismatched records STOP without Pair or identity generation. Requires existing permission and active configuration 5. Sends USBMUX version and setup07, opens one Lockdown connection, QueryType and GetValue(UniqueDeviceID) for association, then exactly one ValidatePair. Never Pair, SetValue, StartSession, TLS, StartService, authentication, networking or projection. Do not approve new Trust prompts. No retries or automatic reconnect. Cleanup and STOP; save report. Existing record is retained on failure.
READ-ONLY QUERYTYPE + PRODUCTTYPE — NO PAIRING OR SESSION
Testing USBMUX init and read-only Lockdown discovery; wait for cleanup and save report...

USBMUX init + read-only Lockdown discovery\n\nRequires already-active configuration 5 and existing USB permission. Prior J/K/L evidence is historical; this action never runs earlier phases automatically. Claims USBMUX with force=false, initializes USBMUX, connects only to Lockdown, sends QueryType and GetValue(ProductType), then releases and closes. No Pair, ValidatePair, StartSession, pairing records, Trust changes, session/service startup, authentication, NCM or projection. Do not approve Trust. Any failure: save the report and STOP; no retry or workaround.
STATE-CHANGING — may save local protected credentials and persist iPhone Trust. Approve Trust only on the iPhone.
Running one explicitly confirmed Pair/ValidatePair attempt; wait for cleanup and save the report…
Another diagnostic is running. Let it finish before starting or confirming this test.

This manual test may persist iPhone Trust and writes UntrustedHostBUID with SetValue. It creates or reuses local protected pairing credentials; it does not export secrets. A PREPARED candidate is saved before Pair and retained if Pair is pending. After Trust approval on the iPhone, a new manual confirmation sends Pair once again using the same candidate. PAIRED (Pair accepted but validation failed/cancelled) and VALIDATED records use ValidatePair only, with no SetValue or Pair. Approve Trust only on the iPhone when prompted. If pending, validation fails, the phone detaches, the app pauses, or cleanup fails: save the report and STOP. No automatic retry, regeneration, Pair fallback, StartSession, TLS, StartService, or projection. Proceed?
ONE USBMUX VERSION REQUEST/REPLY ONLY — NO LOCKDOWN
Testing one USBMUX version exchange; wait for cleanup and save report...

ONE USBMUX VERSION REQUEST/REPLY ONLY — NO LOCKDOWN\n\nRequires already-active configuration 5 and existing USB permission. Earlier E/G must have prepared active5 or STOP; this action never runs E/G/I automatically. Reads GET_CONFIGURATION on the same handle, claims configuration-5 USBMUX once with force=false, sends one 20-byte version request and reads one reply (1000ms per transfer). No retry, fragment continuation, padding discard, SETUP07, Lockdown, pairing, Trust changes, authentication or projection. Releases and closes afterward. Leave Trust untouched; save diagnostic report and STOP.
CLAIM/RELEASE ONLY — NO USBMUX PROTOCOL TRAFFIC. Requires already-active configuration 5 and existing USB permission. One force=false claim, release if successful, close and STOP.

Verify the already-transitioned five-configuration iPhone and Valeria interface-name evidence. Open once, require same-connection GET_CONFIGURATION=5, claim only configuration-5 USBMUX ID1/alt0 with force=false once, release once if claimed, close and STOP. No configuration setter, vendor request, alternate change, driver detach, bulk/interrupt transfer, USBMUX packets or Lockdown. No retry. Public Android claim/release APIs have no timeout argument. Leave Trust This Computer? untouched; do not approve or reject it. Proceed?
Validating active configuration 5 and claiming/releasing USBMUX only…
STATE-CHANGING USB TEST — selects configuration 5 once after read-only preflight. No vendor request, interface claims or transport. Run Phase 3D.2E separately first.

Require the already-transitioned five-configuration iPhone, exact Valeria in configuration 5, existing permission and active configuration 1. Select only value 5 once, verify GET_CONFIGURATION, observe for 10 seconds, close and STOP. No retry or restore. The public Android setter has no timeout argument. Do not approve Trust. Proceed?
Validating/selecting configuration 5 and observing USB state…

Phase 3B.2 NForetek metadata and zero-flag bind discovery. Bluetooth is not accessed at launch. Phase 3A networking, Phase 3B Refresh and Phase 3B.1 inventory remain available. New inspection and bind tests are explicitly manual. No vendor commands, scan, SPP/RFCOMM, iAP2, authentication, CarPlay, USB projection, Wi-Fi Direct, LocalOnlyHotspot or vehicle integration.

Refresh manually reads Android Bluetooth service, adapter and bonded-device visibility once. Opening Settings does not access Bluetooth. Real hardware confirmed active GEELY_BT while Android reports disabled CAR_BT, address 00:00:00:00:00:00 and zero bonded devices. Android APIs cannot confirm current vehicle/MCU Bluetooth state. DiPlay never tries to enable Bluetooth. Scan, RFCOMM and iAP2 remain disabled until vendor integration is identified and transport work is separately approved. Scan support remains unknown without testing.
Scan, RFCOMM and iAP2 tests remain disabled: Geely GEELY_BT is active independently of the disabled Android CAR_BT adapter. Vendor integration must be identified first.

Manual test: binds only to already-running com.nforetek.bt/com.nforetek.bt.service.NfServiceBluetooth with flags=0, reads five audited cached values through the installed vendor Stub.asInterface, then unbinds. No service start/stop, SPP, callbacks, controller queries, pairing, discovery or connection. Values may be stale. Vendor service destruction can affect shared Bluetooth; zero-flag binding does not eliminate lifecycle risk. Keep the vehicle Bluetooth UI active and save the report. Firmware differing from the audited vendor APK is rejected.

Manually copies the two installed vendor base APKs resolved through PackageManager. No root, service invocation or system modification. Tries Download/DiPlayVendorDump on legacy Android with storage permission; otherwise uses app external files. Exact paths, sizes and SHA-256 are displayed and included in the diagnostic report. Supply both APKs locally before Phase 3B.3.
Find and export stock Geely Bluetooth control APK

Manual metadata/file-copy action only. Searches installed package, application and component names for com.neusoft.shockwave.setting.btphonelogic and resolves the BluetoothControlService intent action without invoking it. Exact owning packages are exported with base/split paths, byte counts and SHA-256. If no exact match is visible, candidate packages and components are listed but not exported. No bind/start, broadcasts, callbacks, Bluetooth APIs or controller access. Save diagnostic report and copy exported APKs to the PC for static inspection. Stop after collection; no transport test.

Manual read-only installed package/APK/component/action inventory and native filename discovery. Searches broad Apple/USB/projection/phone/Neusoft terms, not assumed Apple package/library names. Examines readable system lib/lib64 locations and package nativeLibraryDir without recursion or library loading. Ordinary readable candidate base/split APKs and native files are copied to DiPlayVendorDump with exact paths, bytes and SHA-256; denied/missing files and partial results remain visible in the vendor export report above and Save diagnostic report. May copy several large candidate APKs. No services, broadcasts, /dev access, USB roles, Bluetooth commands, iPhone connection or authentication. STOP after inventory/export for PC static inspection; no Phase 3C.
Phase 3B.8 — Full E01 CarPlay system inventory
Read-only system/vendor inventory. Does not activate CarPlay, USB, Bluetooth, Apple services, JNI or authentication.
Phase 3D.2E — Controlled QDrive USB vendor transition
STATE-CHANGING USB TEST — sends one verified QDrive vendor request
QDrive diagnostic running; wait for cleanup and save report...

Manual controlled experiment, separate from read-only tests. First check preflight: one permitted 05AC:12A8 iPhone, active configuration 1/PTP and complete non-Valeria result. Then confirm ONE OUT vendor request 40/52/value 0/index 2/no payload with a 1000ms timeout (QDrive uses unbounded 0). Original connection closes immediately; observe for 10 seconds, then read permitted Apple state only. No retries, configuration changes, claims, bulk or transport. Remove Carlinkit; do not approve Trust. Save report and STOP.

STATE-CHANGING USB TEST — sends one verified QDrive vendor request.\n\nThis may disconnect or change the directly connected iPhone USB state. Preflight will be reverified, then exactly ONE 0x40/0x52/value 0/index 2/length 0 request is allowed. Timeout is 1000ms instead of QDrive’s unbounded 0. No retry, configuration setter, interface claim or transport startup. Observe for 10 seconds and inspect read-only if permission remains. Do not approve Trust. Save report and STOP.
STOP: a USB diagnostic is running. Wait for connection cleanup.

Manual read-only descriptor inspection. Requires existing USB permission. Reads current configuration, raw descriptors and only the interface strings checked by QDrive, using standard GET_DESCRIPTOR requests with 1000ms timeouts. Opens without claims and closes afterward. Neither configuration selection nor vendor mode switching is executed. QDrive matches the case-sensitive substring Valeria, not just exact equality. Remove Carlinkit, connect the unlocked iPhone directly, inspect, save report and STOP. Do not approve Trust or run other USB tests.
STOP: another USB transport test is running. Cancel it before reading configuration.
STOP: GET_CONFIGURATION is running. Wait for its connection cleanup.

Manual read-only standard USB device request ONLY. Requires existing USB permission. Opens the Apple device, sends GET_CONFIGURATION (0x80/0x08, one byte, 1000ms timeout), then immediately closes it. No interface claim, permission request, configuration/alternate-setting change, bulk transfer, USBMUX, Lockdown, pairing, authentication or projection. Correlates the returned configuration value with descriptors; never guesses from array order. Remove Carlinkit, connect the unlocked iPhone directly, press Read, then Save diagnostic report and STOP. Do not run the Phase 3D.2 transport test or approve Trust.

PASSIVE ONLY. Reads Android configuration/interface/alternate-setting and endpoint metadata alongside the flattened interface list. Correlates USBMUX descriptors without selecting an interface or inferring the active configuration. No device open, permission request, claim, configuration change or transfer; no USBMUX, Lockdown, pairing or projection. Remove Carlinkit, connect the unlocked iPhone directly, press Map, then Save diagnostic report. Do not press Test USBMUX + Lockdown or approve Trust. STOP after Phase 3D.2A collection.

Manual transport test ONLY. With Carlinkit removed, connect an unlocked iPhone directly to the driver-side USB port. Requires existing Android USB permission; never requests it. Opens and claims only the descriptor-selected USBMUX interface (255/254/2), performs USBMUX v2 and connects to Lockdown port 62078 for one plaintext GetValue(ProductType) query. No pairing, Trust changes, session/TLS, CarKit, iAP2, MFi, NCM, Bluetooth, AirPlay or CarPlay. Step timeouts are 5 seconds; overall deadline is 25 seconds. Leaving the activity cancels the test. If Trust appears on the iPhone, do not approve it; press Trust prompt appeared — STOP. Save diagnostic report and STOP.

Manual Android USB host descriptor inventory only. Remove the Carlinkit dongle completely. Scan USB port 1 with nothing connected and save the baseline, then connect an unlocked iPhone directly with a known-good data cable and scan again. Do not approve Trust or other prompts. No permission request, device open, interface claim, transfer, USB role/mode change, vendor service, Bluetooth or authentication. Apple VID is only a candidate, not proof of CarPlay. Save diagnostic report, then STOP after Phase 3D.1.

Manual read-only inventory of direct /dev/i2c-* entries and the two I2C sysfs directories only. Reads bounded textual sysfs metadata and symlink information. Does not open device nodes, issue ioctl, access I2C hardware, run the MFi scanner, connect USB/Bluetooth/iPhone, or start CarPlay. Generic addresses such as 0x10/0x11 are not proof of MFi hardware. Press Run, then use Save diagnostic report to export the result.
Collect and export Apple/USB stack files

Manual package metadata and file copy ONLY. Exports com.neusoft.appleservice base/split APKs, readable AppleCore/ApplePrivate JNI libraries, direct ELF dependencies and resolvable config-reference candidates. Uses package library locations and the public Java library search path; no guessed system APK path. No service bind/start, native loading, /dev access, broadcasts, USB role changes, iPhone connection or authentication. Results with exact paths, sizes, SHA-256 and failures appear in the vendor export report above and Save diagnostic report. Config contents are not logged. STOP after collection and supply the files to the PC for static inspection; no Phase 3C.
Inspect services first and wait for completion. Only exported, enabled services with granted permissions can be selected. After pause/resume, inspect again.

Manual inspection records exact known NForetek/Geely service components, permissions and APK interface metadata. Interface classes are loaded without initialization; methods are listed, never invoked. APKs may be unreadable or dependencies missing. Bind requires a separate explicit service selection, uses flags=0 (no auto-create), captures Binder descriptor/class metadata, then immediately unbinds; timeout is 5 seconds. Binding may run vendor onBind/onUnbind lifecycle code. DiPlay sends no vendor methods or manual Binder transactions. Test one service at a time while parked. Pause cancels binding. No Bluetooth enable, pairing, scanning, SPP/RFCOMM, iAP2 or authentication. Save diagnostic report after each test.

Manually inventories visible matching packages, exported components, public running services and readable property-file metadata. No unknown service is invoked or bound, no settings are changed, and no adapter is enabled. After inventory, broadcasts are observed for 30 seconds while you toggle GEELY_BT in the Geely vehicle UI; observation continues while this screen is paused, ends automatically, and stops if this activity is destroyed. Wait for completion, then Save diagnostic report. Broadcast values are omitted except standard adapter state numbers. Results may be restricted; absent metadata does not prove a service is absent. No scan, RFCOMM, iAP2 or authentication.
Enable Bluetooth, pair the iPhone in car settings, then refresh diagnostics and retry.
Bluetooth diagnostic permission denied. Grant the requested permission in app settings and retry.

Read-only network sampling refreshes about every 3 seconds. Start checks stable manual-hotspot readiness and runs a 20-second system NSD test only. No CarPlay handshake. Test peers must advertise _diplay-phase3a._tcp.; observing our own advertisement does not prove laptop reachability. API 22 NSD is platform-scoped, not bound to the selected interface. Pausing the app stops the test.

One manual, read-only framework snapshot. No scans, hotspot changes, Bluetooth discovery, connections or advertisements. SSIDs, addresses and device identifiers are omitted. It cannot establish SoftAP band support or AP+STA concurrency.
